set.body:
Objective
Bridge identified tables and sample keys into Alder through batched access and explicit read/materialization policy. Preserve rich fit artifacts and Train/Validation/Test/Refit roles.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PRED-01, FND-04, FND-07, INF-05. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
predictive integration; predictive adapter in modules/mvpa; modules/mvpa-dataset; admitted Alder integration. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.02, M1.04. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Target-blind stages cannot inspect targets by type; target-aware FeatureMap output is own-target-free under cross-fitting.
2. Scaling, nuisance models, response compression and fitted readout dependencies stay inside training evidence.
3. Learner replay requirements reject a one-shot source or choose an explicit budgeted materialization; no silent rowwise copy explosion.
4. Keep evidence/relational cores independent of Alder and avoid a parallel fit/leakage protocol.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M1.06: Integrate Alder matrix-native data, fitted artifacts, and scoped preparation
